segments.title: CLAUDE'S CREATOR MAKES HISTORY
segments.caption: The biggest IPO on record.
segments.speech: What happens when the company behind Claude makes stock market history?

segments.title: $81.3 BILLION
segments.caption: Gross IPO offering size.
segments.speech: Anthropic priced the largest initial public offering in history, at over eighty-one billion dollars.

segments.title: WHAT IS AN IPO?
segments.caption: Private company → public shares.
segments.speech: But wait, what's an I P O? It's when a company offers its shares to public investors for the first time.

segments.title: NASDAQ: ANT
segments.caption: $83 IPO price, not live price.
segments.speech: Anthropic began trading on Nasdaq on November nineteenth, under the symbol A N T. Its offering price was eighty-three dollars per share.

segments.title: WHY IT MATTERS
segments.caption: More resources for AI development.
segments.speech: Building powerful AI models takes enormous amounts of computing power and research. This could give Anthropic more resources to compete.

segments.title: MONEY ≠ BETTER AI
segments.caption: Funding is not a quality benchmark.
segments.speech: But a bigger valuation doesn't automatically mean better AI!
